_comment: Second Spirlog line per species (plan item 1706), shown once the species is bonded. It ties the species to Rifts and regions. Story area 4 owns this file; Spirlings area 1 owns data/spirlings.json.
Kindlop: Near the Cinder Rift, Kindlop dens burn cold blue. The Hush dims them first.
Smoldrake: Old Smoldrakes nest on the warm rim of mended Rifts, as if guarding the scar.
Calderox: Ashmere gravers say a Calderox stood still at the Kiln Rift for a year and never cooled.
Puddlet: After a storm, Puddlets gather where the Tide Rift opened, humming to the lake.
Riptail: In Corvane the Fading drained Riptail red to grey. Dyers count their colour back as luck.
Leviarch: Leviarchs rise under the Saltglass flats. Ilse says they keep the Glass Rift's lowest note.
Mossling: Mosslings plant themselves at the edge of maps. Cartographers follow them to new ground.
Thornback: Thornbacks in Thornridge curl around Rift stones, as if to hold the edges shut.
Verdantusk: A Verdantusk once walked out of the Mirror Rift. It looked at its reflection and left.
Zippit: Zippits spark brightest when a Rift is near. Wardens used them as early warnings.
Glimmerax: Shed Glimmerax scales make Madderby gold dye. In a Fading year, none are shed.
Shalebat: Shalebats roost in the Greyreach. They fly toward the Wide Rift at dusk and come back.
Obsidroth: Obsidroth hide holds heat for days. Veit Harrow kept one by the guild stove for years.
Zephlet: Some Zephlets come through Rifts with frayed wings. They bond fast, and for life.
Tempestrel: A Tempestrel can hear a Rift open from a valley away. It turns its head toward the tear.
Wickit: Very old Wickits burn paper-pale. Brindlewick says one has been burning far away for forty years.
Lumenewt: In the Mirror Rift a Lumenewt sees only itself. Its Wayfarer has to call it back.
Mirkmole: Mirkmoles dig toward lost things. One, they say, dug toward the Wide Rift and never stopped.
Duskdigger: Duskdiggers tunnel under Rifts. Pim's files say they found the land behind them first.
Kelpup: Kelpups follow ferries across Brindlewick Lake. Aldo feeds them when nobody watches.
Kelphound: A Kelphound howls when its Wayfarer is far away. Wardens say the Hush is full of that sound.
